_comment: Training track secrets. Edit before each event, then rebuild (docker compose run --rm builder). Text flags must be <= 32 ASCII chars. Numeric values: bay_id 1..32767, mb5_value 65536..2147483647 (must need both words), breaker_init 1..32767 with breaker_bit CLEAR, beacon_freq 1..32767.
beacon_clue: the 21-cm hydrogen line, in MHz (whole number)
